steps: Pressure cook the soaked chickpeas in fresh water until tender but still whole.
Drain the chickpeas and let them cool.
Boil the potato, peel it and cut it into small cubes.
Dry-roast the cumin in a pan and crush it to a powder.
Chop the onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander leaves finely.
Put the chickpeas and potato in a big bowl and sprinkle on the salt, chaat masala, cumin and chilli powder.
Squeeze in the lemon and add the chopped vegetables.
Toss well, taste, and serve straight away.
note: Salt is lower than before because chaat masala is already salty; both sources use only a little. This is a snack portion; one source serves a bigger plate with about 65 g of dry chickpeas each.
